# The gao record

<!-- Generated by `gao kho schema -md`. The meanings live in kho/schema.go, beside the type they describe, and a test fails when this file falls behind them. -->

One row is one document. The columns are the same in every gao release, and they are the same for a release that carries text and one that does not: the second is this schema with the text column removed and nothing else changed.

Nothing is nullable. A field no stage filled in is written as the zero value, which is an empty string, a zero, or false. That is a trade made on purpose, because a definition level on every column of half a billion rows costs more than it explains, and what an empty value means is written down here column by column instead.

The filled by column names the gao subcommand that puts the value there. It answers the question a reader asks when a column is empty, which is whether the stage ran and found nothing or never ran at all.

## The columns

All 42 of them, in the order the file holds them.

| column | type | filled by | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `doc_id` | `bytes(32)` | `phoi` | blake3 of the normalized text, which is the document's identity: two documents with the same normalized text are the same document whichever path found them |
| `raw_id` | `bytes(32)` | `gat` | blake3 of the bytes before extraction, which is what links this row back to the WARC record or the source file it came out of |
| `text` | `string` | `phoi` | the document text, normalized to NFC with canonical tone mark placement and legacy encodings already transcoded |
| `schema_version` | `uint16` | `kho` | the version of this layout, carried per row because a store appended to across a pipeline upgrade holds two versions at once and a reader has to be able to tell |
| `source` | `string` | `gat` | which acquisition path produced the document, one of the six gao runs |
| `source_locator` | `string` | `gat` | where in that source it came from: shard and offset for an ingested corpus, file, offset and length for a WARC record |
| `url` | `string` | `gat` | the page it came from, canonicalized |
| `host` | `string` | `gat` | the host of that URL, which is the unit politeness, budgets and takedowns are all measured in |
| `url_template` | `string` | `gat` | the URL with its variable path and query parts replaced by placeholders, which is what the crawl budgets against and how a calendar trap reads as one URL rather than ten thousand |
| `fetched_at` | `timestamp(millisecond)` | `gat` | when the document was fetched, in UTC milliseconds |
| `media_type` | `string` | `gat` | the media type the response declared, before extraction decided what to do with it |
| `extractor` | `string` | `gat` | name and semver of the extractor, because two documents extracted by different versions of the same extractor are not comparable |
| `pipeline_version` | `string` | `kho` | semver of the cleaning pipeline that produced this row |
| `http_status` | `uint16` | `gat` | the status the fetch got, empty for a document that arrived through somebody else's corpus rather than through our crawl |
| `robots_decision` | `string` | `gat` | what robots.txt said about this fetch, recorded per fetch rather than assumed from a global setting so that a consent question years later has an answer |
| `robots_rule` | `string` | `gat` | the rule that decided it, in the spelling the site wrote |
| `robots_hash` | `bytes(32)` | `gat` | blake3 of the robots.txt the decision was made against, so the decision can be rechecked against the file rather than against the file as it is today |
| `tdm_signals` | `map<string, string>` | `gat` | the machine readable text and data mining reservations the response carried, keyed by mechanism and holding what that mechanism said |
| `consent` | `string` | `gat` | what the page said about being kept and trained on, in one word, where empty means nobody asked rather than the page said yes |
| `lang` | `string` | `sang` | the language identifier's verdict, which is vie for everything in gao and is stored anyway because a column that is constant today needs no migration tomorrow |
| `lang_score` | `float32` | `sang` | how sure the identifier was |
| `diacritics` | `string` | `sang` | present, absent or mixed, because Vietnamese written without tone marks is still Vietnamese and is still not the same distribution |
| `translated` | `bool` | `sang` | the machine translation detector's verdict, since translated Vietnamese reads as fluent to a metric and as wrong to a native speaker |
| `gao_qual` | `float32` | `sang` | the quality classifier's score for this document |
| `gao_edu` | `float32` | `sang` | the educational value score, which is what the gao-edu slice is selected on |
| `hplt_bucket` | `uint8` | `gat` | the source corpus's own quality bucket where it had one, kept so gao's classifier can be compared against an independent one rather than only against itself |
| `register` | `string` | `gat` | the source corpus's own register label, kept for the same reason |
| `heuristics` | `map<string, float32>` | `sang` | the raw heuristic measurements rather than the verdicts, so the corpus can be refiltered at a different threshold without being recomputed from the text |
| `dup_cluster` | `bytes(16)` | `xay` | which duplicate cluster the document belongs to, empty when it is in none |
| `dup_cluster_size` | `uint32` | `xay` | how large that cluster is |
| `is_representative` | `bool` | `xay` | marks the one document per cluster a deduplicated view keeps, with the rest left in the store because deduplication is tuned rather than maximized |
| `pii_level` | `uint8` | `che` | how much personal data has been removed: none, the structured identifiers, or those plus addresses and identifying names |
| `pii_types` | `list<string>` | `che` | which kinds of personal data were found |
| `pii_spans` | `list<span>` | `che` | where they were found, present at levels 0 and 1 and absent at level 2, because shipping the offsets of redacted data alongside the redacted text re-identifies it |
| `license_class` | `string` | `luat` | the per document redistribution determination, stored by name so a file read without gao says restricted rather than 3 |
| `license_evidence` | `string` | `luat` | what determined that class, since a class without evidence is a guess |
| `structure` | `string` | `gat` | what the document is: article, forum thread, legal, thesis, gazette, transcript, which drives both the extraction handler and the mixture weights |
| `n_chars` | `uint32` | `phoi` | how many characters the text holds |
| `n_syllables` | `uint32` | `phoi` | how many Vietnamese syllables it holds, which is the unit that survives a change of tokenizer |
| `n_tokens` | `uint32` | `dem` | how many gao tokens it holds, under the tokenizer named in the manifest |
| `contam_flags` | `list<string>` | `nhat` | which evaluation benchmarks this document overlaps, flagged rather than deleted so one store can serve a training run that excludes them and an analysis that counts them |
| `upstream_fields` | `map<string, string>` | `gat` | the source corpus's own metadata, verbatim, which is the difference between answering a provenance question later and having to ingest again |

These are dictionary encoded: `source`, `host`, `url_template`, `media_type`, `extractor`, `pipeline_version`, `robots_decision`, `robots_rule`, `consent`, `lang`, `diacritics`, `register`, `license_class`, `license_evidence`, `structure`, `pii_spans.type`. That is a property of the file rather than of the data, and it is worth saying out loud because it is the difference between a filter on host reading one dictionary per row group and reading every row.

## Inside pii_spans

`pii_spans` is a list, and each element has three fields.

| column | type | filled by | meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `pii_spans.start` | `uint32` | `che` | byte offset into the text where the identifier begins |
| `pii_spans.len` | `uint32` | `che` | how many bytes long it is, counted in bytes rather than runes because a reader slicing the text has bytes |
| `pii_spans.type` | `string` | `che` | which kind of identifier it is, from the same set pii_types draws on |

The spans are present at redaction levels 0 and 1 and absent at level 2. Shipping the offsets of what was redacted alongside the redacted text hands back most of what the redaction removed.

## What Parquet sees

The physical types, as a Parquet tool prints them.

```
message document {
	required fixed_len_byte_array(32) doc_id;
	required fixed_len_byte_array(32) raw_id;
	required binary text (STRING);
	required int32 schema_version (INT(16,false));
	required binary source (STRING);
	required binary source_locator (STRING);
	required binary url (STRING);
	required binary host (STRING);
	required binary url_template (STRING);
	required int64 fetched_at (TIMESTAMP(isAdjustedToUTC=true,unit=MILLIS));
	required binary media_type (STRING);
	required binary extractor (STRING);
	required binary pipeline_version (STRING);
	required int32 http_status (INT(16,false));
	required binary robots_decision (STRING);
	required binary robots_rule (STRING);
	required fixed_len_byte_array(32) robots_hash;
	required group tdm_signals (MAP) {
		repeated group key_value {
			required binary key (STRING);
			required binary value (STRING);
		}
	}
	required binary consent (STRING);
	required binary lang (STRING);
	required float lang_score;
	required binary diacritics (STRING);
	required boolean translated;
	required float gao_qual;
	required float gao_edu;
	required int32 hplt_bucket (INT(8,false));
	required binary register (STRING);
	required group heuristics (MAP) {
		repeated group key_value {
			required binary key (STRING);
			required float value;
		}
	}
	required fixed_len_byte_array(16) dup_cluster;
	required int32 dup_cluster_size (INT(32,false));
	required boolean is_representative;
	required int32 pii_level (INT(8,false));
	required group pii_types (LIST) {
		repeated group list {
			required binary element (STRING);
		}
	}
	required group pii_spans (LIST) {
		repeated group list {
			required group element {
				required int32 start (INT(32,false));
				required int32 len (INT(32,false));
				required binary type (STRING);
			}
		}
	}
	required binary license_class (STRING);
	required binary license_evidence (STRING);
	required binary structure (STRING);
	required int32 n_chars (INT(32,false));
	required int32 n_syllables (INT(32,false));
	required int32 n_tokens (INT(32,false));
	required group contam_flags (LIST) {
		repeated group list {
			required binary element (STRING);
		}
	}
	required group upstream_fields (MAP) {
		repeated group key_value {
			required binary key (STRING);
			required binary value (STRING);
		}
	}
}
```

## When this changes

`schema_version` is a column rather than a line in the manifest, because a store appended to across a pipeline upgrade holds two versions of the layout at once and a reader has to be able to tell which row is which. A column is never renamed and never changes meaning, since a column name in a released dataset is somebody else's query. The way this schema grows is a new column and a higher version, which leaves a reader who has never heard of the new column working.
